question: Is there an official Quezon Provincial Agriculturist request path for existing freshwater fish survey data relevant to the Yabahan River lead?
purpose: Prepare a transparent, narrowly scoped inquiry for existing, potentially shareable freshwater fish survey records while keeping the request route separate from fish evidence.

findings.evidence: The official Quezon Office of the Provincial Agriculturist service page lists a communication letter stating the request as the requirement for agriculture and fishery data/statistics requests. It says the letter may be sent by email or hand-carried, the office will coordinate/endorse the request, and data may be received in person or by email.
supports: an official process route for asking whether provincial agriculture/fishery data are available
doesNotSupport: existence of a Yabahan River fish survey
availability or release of any dataset
fish taxa, sampling stations, current presence, or completeness
permission to redistribute a report, table, or data

scope: existing survey/study records for Yabahan River and the source spelling Yabahaan
a catalog or referral to separately identified Quezon freshwater surveys for rivers, lakes, reservoirs, and wetlands
dates, source names, locality/station crosswalk, methods, identification/voucher details, and item-specific reuse terms
draft.privacy: No email address, phone number, fisher personal data, or other contact details are included. A placeholder remains for Joseph to decide what contact details to add before sending.

nextActions: Keep the letter unsent until Joseph chooses to review and send it through the official process.
Continue independent public searches for site-resolved Quezon river and lake fish surveys while awaiting any response.
Review any response at the source, locality, sampling, taxonomy, and reuse levels before recording species evidence.
nonClaims: No response or dataset has been received.
No fish presence or absence, complete species list, current catchability, diet, safety, water quality, access, fishing rule, route, or geometry is established.
The official service page documents a way to ask for data; it does not show what data the office holds or whether a request will be approved.
